user_text: @_user_1 查询2026-06-24对比2026-06-23销量下滑最多的5个asin，以及6月24日的当日销量和转化率
error: 业务规则校验失败：ROUND(expr, 位数) 中的除法结果必须整体转为 numeric，或确保分子分母均为 numeric
sql:
WITH daily_stats AS (
    SELECT
        childasin,
        report_date::date AS day,
        SUM(salesbyasin_unitsordered) AS units_sold,
        SUM(trafficbyasin_sessions) AS sessions
    FROM amazon_3p_sales_and_traffic_innerbrightness
    WHERE report_date::date IN ('2026-06-23', '2026-06-24')
      AND country_code = 'US'
      AND customer = 'innerbrightness'
    GROUP BY childasin, report_date::date
),
prev AS (
    SELECT childasin, units_sold AS prev_units
    FROM daily_stats
    WHERE day = '2026-06-23'
),
curr AS (
    SELECT childasin, units_sold AS curr_units, sessions AS curr_sessions
    FROM daily_stats
    WHERE day = '2026-06-24'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        curr.childasin,
        COALESCE(prev.prev_units, 0) AS units_prev,
        curr.curr_units,
        curr.curr_sessions,
        COALESCE(prev.prev_units, 0) - curr.curr_units AS decline
    FROM curr
    LEFT JOIN prev ON curr.childasin = prev.childasin
    WHERE COALESCE(prev.prev_units, 0) > curr.curr_units
)
SELECT
    childasin AS "ASIN",
    curr_units AS "当日销量 (2026-06-24)",
    ROUND(
        (curr_units::numeric / NULLIF(curr_sessions, 0)), 4
    ) AS "当日转化率",
    units_prev AS "前日销量 (2026-06-23)",
    decline AS "下滑量"
FROM ranked
ORDER BY decline DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH top5 AS (
    SELECT
        advertised_asin,
        SUM(cost) AS ad_spend
    FROM amazon_ads_sp_advertised_product_innerbrightness

    SELECT
        t.advertised_asin,
        SUM(a.cost)      AS ad_spend,

        ON t.advertised_asin = a.advertised_asin
        AND a.date::date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
        AND a.date::date <  DATE '2026-07-01'
        AND a.country_code_request = 'US'
        AND a.customer_request = 'INNERBRIGHTNESS'
    GROUP BY t.advertised_asin
),
br_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        t.advertised_asin,
        SUM(s.salesbyasin_orderedproductsales_amount) AS br_sales

    LEFT JOIN amazon_3p_sales_and_traffic_innerbrightness s
        ON t.advertised_asin = s.childasin
        AND s.report_date >= DATE '2026-06-01'
        AND s.report_date <  DATE '2026-07-01'
        AND s.country_code = 'US'
        AND s.customer = 'innerbrightness'
    GROUP BY t.advertised_asin

SELECT

    ROUND(a.ad_spend, 2) AS ad_spend,

    ROUND((a.ad_spend / NULLIF(a.ad_sales, 0))::numeric, 4) AS acos
FROM top5 t
LEFT JOIN ad_metrics a ON t.advertised_asin = a.advertised_asin
LEFT JOIN br_metrics b ON t.advertised_asin = b.advertised_asin

WITH
day23 AS (
    SELECT
        childasin,
        SUM(salesbyasin_unitsordered) AS units_23,
        SUM(trafficbyasin_sessions) AS sessions_23
    FROM amazon_3p_sales_and_traffic_innerbrightness
    WHERE report_date = '2026-06-23'
      AND country_code = 'US'
      AND customer = 'innerbrightness'
    GROUP BY childasin
),
day24 AS (
    SELECT
        childasin,
        SUM(salesbyasin_unitsordered) AS units_24,
        SUM(trafficbyasin_sessions) AS sessions_24
    FROM amazon_3p_sales_and_traffic_innerbrightness
    WHERE report_date = '2026-06-24'
      AND country_code = 'US'
      AND customer = 'innerbrightness'
    GROUP BY childasin
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(d23.childasin, d24.childasin) AS asin,
    COALESCE(d24.units_24, 0)               AS units_sold_0624,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(d24.sessions_24, 0) > 0
        THEN ROUND(
                 COALESCE(d24.units_24, 0)::numeric
                 / d24.sessions_24,
                 4)
        ELSE NULL
    END                                     AS conversion_rate_0624,
    COALESCE(d24.units_24, 0)
    - COALESCE(d23.units_23, 0)             AS unit_change
FROM day23 d23
FULL OUTER JOIN day24 d24
    ON d23.childasin = d24.childasin
WHERE COALESCE(d23.units_23, 0) > 0
   OR COALESCE(d24.units_24, 0) > 0
ORDER BY unit_change ASC
